subject: Security form routing + HIPAA scope clarifications (SIG vs CAIQ)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Li <k.li@mediflow.com>, Mediflow Security <security@mediflow.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security form routing + HIPAA scope clarifications (SIG vs CAIQ)

Hi Katie — thanks again for the call this morning, appreciate you walking through the Mediflow use case. Quick recap and a few concrete asks so we can get your security intake started: 

Summary from call:
- Mediflow plans to put PHI through text extraction and classification (incoming clinical notes -> normalized metadata).
- You asked for our SOC 2 posture, BAA support, and a sense for what evidence items we can provide.
- Primary concern is HIPAA compliance and data residency in US only for currently scoped environments.

Asks / next steps:
1) Which questionnaire would you prefer us to start with for vendor review: SIG Lite, full SIG (Consensus), or CAIQ? We can prefill any of these — SIG Lite is quickest, CAIQ is useful if you need cloud provider mapping.
2) Confirm: PHI will be limited to structured text fields and extracted PII/PHI — no raw audio or imaging for this phase, correct?
3) Confirm whether Mediflow requires a BAA signed before we share SOC 2 artifacts (Type I completed; Type II in progress).
4) Please confirm desired log retention window (you mentioned 2 years on the call) and any special access control requirements (e.g., separate service accounts per environment).

I'm attaching a prefilling template (redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx) so your security team can see the mapping and reduce initial review friction. Olga from our security team is CC'd — she'll follow up with evidence mapping and specific control-level clarifications.

Proposed timeline: if we get your questionnaire choice + BAA direction by Wed 28 Apr, we can return a completed SIG-Lite prefill + evidence checklist within 5 business days.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call (15–20m) with your security lead if that helps.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx

From: Katie Li <k.li@mediflow.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mediflow Security <security@mediflow.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security form routing + HIPAA scope clarifications (SIG vs CAIQ)

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Questionnaire preference: we'd like you to start with SIG Lite if that's available — it speeds procurement. If we need deeper cloud control mapping later we'll request the CAIQ.
2) HIPAA scope: yes, this will involve PHI (clinical notes + patient identifiers). We will need a signed BAA before we accept production onboarding.
3) SOC 2: we understand Type II is in progress; please note our procurement requires either a current Type II or an attestation and a plan for Type II completion. If you only have Type I, can you provide any interim compensating controls?
4) Retention & logs: we currently require 2 years retention for audit logs and a minimum of 90 days for application request logs. We also require role-based access controls + SSO with SCIM provisioning.

Can Olga send a sample evidence list (PDF or sheet) showing the exact artifacts you'll provide? Also — are your encryption keys customer-managed (BYOK) or managed by Redwood?

Happy to set a 30-min security call Wed afternoon; I'm available 2–4pm PT.

Thanks,
Katie Li
Head of Product Security
Mediflow Health
k.li@mediflow.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Li <k.li@mediflow.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security form routing + HIPAA scope clarifications (SIG vs CAIQ)

Katie — great to meet you virtually. Thanks for the quick clarifications. A few follow-up control-level questions to make sure the prefill and evidence package hit your procurement checklist: 

1) Workflows that touch PHI: can you confirm whether any unstructured attachments (PDFs, images) will be routed to Redwood in this phase, or strictly text fields? If attachments will be sent later we need to scope storage encryption and scanning policies.
2) Tokenization & retention: do you require us to perform tokenization on ingestion or can Mediflow handle tokenization post-response? What is your required maximum retention window for raw inputs in production?
3) Key mgmt: Redwood currently offers provider-managed encryption keys by default; we support customer-managed keys (KMS) for Dedicated and Private deployments. Which deployment model will Mediflow evaluate for production?
4) Logs & monitoring: you mentioned 2-year retention for audit logs — can you confirm whether you require exportable immutable logs for third-party auditors?
5) Evidence types: we'll include the SOC 2 Type I report, our security policy bundle, penetration test summary, and control-mapped artifacts where available. I'm attaching a short evidence checklist (redwood_evidence_checklist.pdf) showing examples and expected turnaround times.

If SIG Lite is your starting point, we'll prefill and mark items where we expect customer-provided evidence (e.g., SSO provisioning config). If you prefer CAIQ instead we'll map controls to cloud provider artifacts.

Vanessa — I'm available Wed 28 Apr 10–12 or 14–16 PT to join the call and walk the security team through the prefill. Katie — does 14:30 PT on Wed work?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Principal Security Engineer, Vendor Risk
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Li <k.li@mediflow.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security form routing + HIPAA scope clarifications (SIG vs CAIQ)

Perfect — 14:30 PT Wed works great. I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in and attach the prefills.

Immediate actions from Redwood (we'll complete these once you confirm BAA requirement):
- Send SIG Lite prefill (attached) and evidence checklist (PDF) — Olga will lead the mapping.
- Confirm KMS options for Dedicated vs Hosted and sample config docs in the evidence pack.
- Prepare a short controls Q&A for your procurement checklist items that typically block SOC2/BAA review.

Katie — if you'd like the prefill earlier I can push a filled draft before the call; otherwise we'll use the call to walk through any high-touch items.

See you Wed 14:30 PT.

Best,
Vanessa
